meta.source: FlyWire connectome v783 (Dorkenwald et al. 2024, Nature 634:124; Schlegel et al. 2024, Nature 634:139) as packaged for the Shiu et al. 2024 (Nature, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9) whole-brain LIF model by github.com/eonsystemspbc/fly-brain (2025_Connectivity_783.parquet)
meta.licence: FlyWire public-release data (v783) is CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial, attribution): cite Dorkenwald et al. 2024, Nature 634:124 and Schlegel et al. 2024, Nature 634:139 (FlyWire), and Shiu et al. 2024 for the LIF model. This file is a derived, pruned and integer-scaled subset (see demos/fly.py, docs/fly_circuit.md); NOT for commercial use.
meta.scaling: w_ji = clip(round(count_ji * 0.392857), +-200) for excitatory synapses, clip(round(count_ji * 0.392857), +-200) for inhibitory ones; 0.392857 = g * theta / 7mV * 0.275mV * 5ms / 20ms with ONE global g = 0.4, inhibitory/excitatory ratio 1.0; no per-neuron gains, no damping; count = signed (Excitatory column) FlyWire synapse count; leak = round(lam * theta * dt_ms / 20ms), lam = 0.15
meta.input: external lines are the gustatory receptor neurons (GRNs), one Bernoulli spike train per line per step with p = rate * dt; sugar group at 200 Hz for sugar, bitter group at 200 Hz for bitter
meta.criterion: candidates: non-GRN neurons firing >= min_rate Hz in the float full-brain model under sugar, sugar+bitter or bitter; ranked by activity-weighted backward influence on MN9 (max over conditions); top n kept; synapses with |count| < c_min dropped to fit nnz <= 4000
